title: Returning Monthly Active Listeners
description:
Compute the **Day 1 User Retention Rate** from an app login log table `logins(user_id, login_date)`.

Day 1 retention is defined as the fraction of newly registered users who logged in on the day immediately following their registration date ($D+1$).
